I am a woman with no schooling, farming a small maize plot in the North East. The land is mine but money is tight, so I must be careful. Maize needs some fertilizer to give a good harvest here in the savanna, so I will buy a little NPK and urea if I can — maybe one bag spread over the plot. I will use the local seed I saved from last year because improved seed costs too much and the agro-dealer is far. My children and I will do most of the work, but at planting and weeding time I will call a few hands to help.
